_readme: The only metrics the proposal step may choose. Validity per shape mirrors the table in 02-prompts/shapes.md; 'primary' marks the headline candidate. A shape not listed under a metric means that cell is ✗ or — and the metric is never proposed for it. Edit this file, not the script, to change the rules.

shapes.branded: the prompt names your brand or one of its products
shapes.conquest: the prompt names a tracked competitor but not you
shapes.list: names no product; asks for options, a shortlist, a recommendation or a product finder
shapes.task: names no product; asks how to do a job, set something up, or fix a problem
shapes.category: names no product; asks about the category, a concept, a definition, a decision or whether something is worth it
shapes.none: no answer to this prompt could reasonably name a brand in your market (news, health, homework, creative, off-topic); only citation metrics apply

notes.branded: expect ~100%; a miss is a grading bug, not a finding
notes.category: unprompted: nobody asked for an organisation. Near 0 for software brands; for a charity or information resource, being named here may be the point

top_three_rate.label: Top-three rate (when mentioned)
top_three_rate.formula: answers ranking you <=3 / answers naming you

win_rate.label: Win rate
win_rate.denominator: eligible answers that name a winner

notes.list: only answers whose verdict is in a comparison with you (per-answer rule)

capture.label: Capture
capture.formula: answers recommending you as a tool / answers recommending any named tool
capture.denominator: answers that recommend a named tool

tool_recommendation_rate.label: Tool-recommendation rate
tool_recommendation_rate.formula: answers recommending any named tool / all answers

cohort_sov.label: Cohort share of voice
cohort_sov.formula: your mentions / mentions of you + tracked competitors

negative_rate.label: Negative rate (negative + mixed)
negative_rate.formula: negative or mixed answers / answers naming you

owned_citation_share.label: Owned-citation share
owned_citation_share.formula: confirmed citations to your domains / all confirmed citations

never: a rival winning a rival-named prompt is the expected result, not your loss
task answers rarely pick a winner; when they do it's one tool for one step: that's capture
if the prompt didn't ask about you, claims about you are incidental
you're barely mentioned; neutral dominates and says nothing
you are the subject, so position is always 1
